hero.lead: Enjoy our signature coconut coffee, fruit teas and ice-cold sodas by the Cổ Cò river after your time in the saddle.
hero.signatureText: Bold coffee meets a smooth, creamy coconut layer, the perfect cool-down after every ride.

sunset.title: Sunset Corner on the Cổ Cò Riverbank
sunset.text: Sip an iced coconut coffee, listen to unhurried hoofbeats and feel the cool breeze off the river.
